title: Venato
extract:
The Venato is a Sentient scythe and the Signature Weapon of  Caliban, with attacks having a 50% chance to gain an additional Melee Combo point in his hands.

Characteristics
This weapon deals primarily  Puncture damage.
Stance slot has  polarity, matching  Stalking Fan stance.
Can use the Venato-exclusive  Sentient Incision mod.
When wielded by  Caliban/ Caliban Prime, attacks have a 50% chance to generate an additional Melee Combo point.
Advantages over other Melee   weapons (excluding modular weapons):

Normal Attack (wiki attack index 1)
High crit chance (27.00%)
Above average total damage (220)
Above average damage × attack speed (308.16)
Very high block angle (90°)
Above average follow through (0.6x)
High attack speed (1.080x animation speed)
Above average attack range (2.70 m)
Above average disposition (●●●●○ (1.30x))
Above average crit multiplier (2.10x)
Slam Attack (wiki attack index 2)
High crit chance (27.00%)
Above average total damage (440)
High attack speed (1.080x animation speed)
Very high block angle (90°)
Above average follow through (0.6x)
Above average damage × attack speed (616.33)
Above average attack range (2.70 m)
Above average disposition (●●●●○ (1.30x))
Above average crit multiplier (2.10x)
Heavy Slam Attack (wiki attack index 3)
High crit chance (27.00%)
Above average total damage (660)
High attack speed (1.080x animation speed)
Very high block angle (90°)
Above average follow through (0.6x)
High damage × attack speed (924.50)
Above average attack range (2.70 m)
Above average disposition (●●●●○ (1.30x))
Above average crit multiplier (2.10x)
Highest innate block angle of all melee weapons, tied with  Tenet Grigori of scythes, and tied with  Ghoulsaw,  Vastilok, and  Tenet Agendus.
Disadvantages over other Melee   weapons (excluding modular weapons):

Normal Attack (wiki attack index 1)
No numerical disadvantages.
Slam Attack (wiki attack index 2)
Very low status chance (10.00%)
Heavy Slam Attack (wiki attack index 3)
Very low status chance (10.00%)
See WARFRAME Wiki:Stat Comparison/Percentiles for more details.
Comparisons:

 Venato (Normal Attack), compared to  Venato Prime (Normal Attack):
Lower base damage (220.00 vs. 245.00)
Lower  Impact damage ( 33 vs.  36.75)
Lower  Puncture damage ( 110 vs.  122.5)
Lower  Slash damage ( 77 vs.  85.75)
Lower total damage (220 vs. 245)
Lower base critical chance (27.00% vs. 34.00%)
Lower base critical multiplier (2.10x vs. 2.30x)
Lower base status chance (24.00% vs. 32.00%)
Shorter melee range (2.70 m vs. 2.80 m)
Lower attack speed (1.080x animation speed vs. 1.166x animation speed)
Higher Block Angle (90° vs. 60°)
Less polarities (None vs. )
Lower Mastery Rank required (9 vs. 14)
Higher disposition (●●●●○ (1.30x) vs. ●○○○○ (0.60x))

Acquisition
The Venato's blueprint can be researched from the Tenno Lab in the dojo.

History
Previously, the only way to acquire the Venato was through Narmer Bounties on Cetus and Fortuna.

Notes
Beginning melee attacks will emit a single flash of light several meters in front of the Warframe.
This light has no apparent function.
